narr: A few severe thunderstorms developed along the M-59 corridor, producing both hail and damaging winds, with flooding also occuring over parts of Macomb and Wayne counties. Rainfall totals of 2 to 2.5 inches were observed over a short period.
ev: The Michigan Department of Transportation reporting flooding closing sections of I-94 and I-75.
The Michigan Department of Transportation reported flooding on I-94 and Gratiot Ave closing all lanes.
